NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed one new commit that adds a regression test case. The description, checklist and commit structure are unchanged, and the comment says only that the PR was compared against the guide using an LLM.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | A regression test case was added in `markdown_test_cases.json`, which also answers the author's own question about test location. |
| ❌  | The self-review checklist is a custom list, not the PR template's checklist (motivation/approach, CI, edge cases, commit discipline, impact). The closed PR #38363 was criticized for this same problem. |
| ❌  | Commits aren't organized per the commit discipline guide: "fixed linting error to pass CI" and "Fixes #17419" are separate fixup-style commits, the test sits in its own commit, and none of the messages use the `area: summary.` format. |
| ⚠️  | Before/after screenshots are in a comment, not in the PR description. The description also has a typo ("methon") and the test commit says "17418". |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and give more feedback.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the test! Two things are still needed before review: please replace the self-review checklist with the one from the PR template, and squash your commits so each one is a complete change with a message in the `markdown: Preserve tabs in code blocks.` style, per the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). Please also move the screenshots into the PR description.
```
